name: webkitgtk
description: Linux WebKitGTK, GTK 3, and libsoup development headers required to compile Wails desktop applications
installHint: Install the approved WebKitGTK 4.1, GTK 3, and libsoup 3 development packages with `sudo vrooli setup`
privilegeReason: The approved Linux development headers are installed through the operator-owned host setup flow.
notes: The declared WebKitGTK development package brings the GTK 3 and libsoup 3 headers required by the Wails Linux build. The handler checks all pkg-config modules instead of treating pkg-config itself as proof that headers are installed.
